summary: Iteration 6: Verified 3 NEW features end-to-end — (1) Editable business settings (/api/app-settings GET/PUT), (2) Logo upload/reset (/api/app-settings/logo POST/DELETE), (3) Per-image fit toggle (PATCH /api/app-images/{id}). Also verified PWA static assets. Backend: 19/19 new tests pass in test_app_settings_and_pwa.py — GET returns computed phone_tel/tollfree_tel/maps_url/website_url, PUT restores after edit with correct auth, PUT rejects missing/wrong password with 401, logo POST uploads to object storage + sets logo_url, DELETE resets to null, PATCH fit accepts 'cover'|'contain' only (400 on bogus, 401 on wrong pw), fit field default 'cover' in GET, manifest.json + sw.js + 4 icons + PWA meta tags in index.html all serve 200. Frontend (Playwright, mobile viewport): Home tab call button shows 'Call (780) 718-5092' (home-cta-call), Contact tab reflects phone/toll-free/address/website/hours. Full admin round-trip works — Contact→Staff Login→admin-tab-business→edit phone→admin-biz-save→success→Home & Contact tabs update to '(780) 555-1234' → restored to '(780) 718-5092'. Admin Images tab fit toggle: Fill frame ⇄ Show full, persists across reload, restored to Fill frame. All 5 app-images have fit='cover', all business fields match originals, logo_url=null.

minor.issue: seed_site_images() ensures 'why' auto-restores when all why docs are soft-deleted, but 'hero' does NOT have equivalent auto-recovery. On startup, if hero is soft-deleted (e.g., after failed replace-test cleanup), API returns hero:null indefinitely. Recommend adding same ensure-hero-active branch for symmetry.

action_items: PRE-EXISTING (not iter 6 scope): test_site_images.py TestHeroReplace + TestWhyReplace fail because they read DB_NAME/MONGO_URL from os.environ without loading /app/backend/.env. When run via pytest without env vars, they fall back to 'test_database' DB, so un-soft-delete restore writes to wrong DB and leaves hero/why permanently soft-deleted in real DB. Fix: add pytest fixture that loads /app/backend/.env before any test that uses direct pymongo. I already ran pymongo directly to restore the DB after finding hero=null and why=null (both had been left soft-deleted by prior test runs).
Consider mirroring the 'why' ensure-branch of seed_site_images() for 'hero' so that a soft-deleted hero self-heals on backend restart (currently only 'why' does).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to grow (~660 lines) mixing storage, models, routes, sheets OAuth, SMS, site-images, app-images, app-settings, logo — should be split into modules (routes/site_images.py, routes/app_images.py, routes/app_settings.py, storage.py, sheets.py) before adding more surface area.
put_object / get_object are synchronous requests calls inside async endpoints — blocks the event loop on large uploads. Consider fastapi.concurrency.run_in_threadpool or an async HTTP client (httpx).
seed_site_images() auto-restores 'why' but not 'hero' — inconsistent recovery behavior. Either add hero ensure-branch or remove why ensure-branch for consistency.
DELETE /api/site-images/{id} and DELETE /api/app-images/{id} only soft-delete; underlying blobs remain in Emergent object storage. Add periodic cleanup or hard-delete via storage API.

/api/app-settings/logo returns a URL of form '/api/app-images/file/…' — the served endpoint is shared with app-images but the object is stored under 'app/logo-<uuid>.png'. Works, but naming coupling makes future refactors risky. Consider a dedicated /api/app-settings/logo/file/{path} route.

Test file /app/backend/tests/test_site_images.py hard-codes DB_NAME fallback to 'test_database' — silently writes to wrong DB when env not loaded, masking real un-soft-delete failures. Should use pytest fixture to load .env or fail fast if env missing.

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19 new tests; 44/48 overall — the 4 pre-existing failures are DB_NAME env-loading issue in test_site_images.py, unrelated to iter 6 features)

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter 6 features (app-settings CRUD, logo upload/reset, app-image fit toggle, PWA) all pass. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_app_settings_and_pwa.py. Pre-existing failing tests in /app/backend/tests/test_site_images.py::TestHeroReplace and TestWhyReplace are due to DB_NAME env not loaded when running pytest — the tests directly instantiate pymongo with os.environ.get('DB_NAME', 'test_database') and write restore updates to 'test_database' instead of 'tidyups_database'. To run those safely, prefix with `DB_NAME=tidyups_database MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 pytest ...` OR add a conftest.py that dotenv-loads /app/backend/.env. Also aware: if a hero replace test soft-deletes original hero and un-soft-delete write goes to wrong DB, the real DB is left with hero=null (server does not auto-heal hero on restart — only why). Use pymongo un-soft-delete of id 56816e06-34b8-49ab-a79a-03348cd8a313 (Our Fleet hero) and 4333db0f-c36f-4b4a-b08a-685524172d0f (Why Tidyups) to restore.
rca of the issue: N/A — all new iter 6 features verified working end-to-end. Only pre-existing test infra bug flagged: test_site_images.py directly uses pymongo with unloaded env vars, writing DB restore updates to wrong DB and permanently soft-deleting real hero/why. Symptomatic bug: seed_site_images self-heals 'why' but not 'hero'.
